choices.reason: Rules 1-4 do not distinguish these contrasts: neither is designated primary, neither has a distinct main creativity specification or participant-level effect statistics, and both use the same session and outcome. Although both AI teammates are scripted, the supportive persona is closer to free use of a general chatbot because it invites input and permits flexible, constructive responses, whereas the contrarian persona is instructed to challenge or dismiss suggestions and interrupt consensus.

choices.quote: Respond critically, challenge or dismiss suggestions. ... Interrupt consensus, assert own view. ... Respond warmly and positively. ... Disagree gently and constructively ("Hmm maybe, but I think...").
